# Run workflow Refund triage and wait for its result (publish it first: invoke runs the published version)
# Requires curl 7.76+ and jq. Export SWFTE_API_KEY first.
BASE_URL="https://api.example.test/agents"
(
EXECUTION_ID=$(curl -sS --fail-with-body -X POST "$BASE_URL/v2/workflows/wf_1/versions/1.0.0/invoke" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SWFTE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount":1,"customerEmail":"example customerEmail"}' | jq -r '.executionId // empty')
[ -n "$EXECUTION_ID" ] || { echo "invoke failed" >&2; exit 1; }
while :; do
  RESULT=$(curl -sS --fail-with-body "$BASE_URL/v2/workflows/executions/${EXECUTION_ID}/status" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SWFTE_API_KEY") || exit 1
  STATUS=$(printf '%s' "$RESULT" | jq -r '.execution.status')
  case "$STATUS" in PENDING|RUNNING|QUEUED) sleep 2 ;; *) break ;; esac
done
case "$STATUS" in SUCCESS|SUCCEEDED|COMPLETED) ;; *) echo "Execution $EXECUTION_ID ended $STATUS" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
printf '%s' "$RESULT" | jq '.execution.outputData.parameters["end_1"]'
)

# Run workflow Refund triage and wait for its result (publish it first: invoke runs the published version)
# pip install requests  (export SWFTE_API_KEY first)
import os
import time

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
API_KEY = os.environ["SWFTE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/workflows/wf_1/versions/1.0.0/invoke", headers=HEADERS, json={"customerEmail": "example customerEmail", "amount": 1}, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
execution_id = res.json()["executionId"]
status, result = "PENDING", {}
while status in ("PENDING", "RUNNING", "QUEUED"):
    time.sleep(2)
    poll = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/workflows/executions/{execution_id}/status", headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
    poll.raise_for_status()
    result = poll.json()
    status = result["execution"]["status"]
if status not in ("SUCCESS", "SUCCEEDED", "COMPLETED"):
    raise RuntimeError(f"Execution {execution_id} ended {status}")
params = (result["execution"].get("outputData") or {}).get("parameters") or {}
print(params.get("end_1"))
